guide_quotes: Publicly use **Hill, McHardy & Herbst** or **Hill, McHardy & Herbst Inc.**
General legal education is context, not personalised legal advice.
One useful idea per post/video is usually stronger than cramming several legal points together.
clients.audienceAndIntent: Help a person approaching Hill, McHardy & Herbst understand which verified service category fits their question, and help legal practitioners recognise correspondent work. These are topic intents, not an asserted demographic or a promise of a legal result.
clients.formatsAndRationale: Three design posters per month support one clear legal topic each, with a direct title and short explanation. Professional video, photo posts, reels and animation are unconfirmed and receive no allocated work. Prefer real office context when an approved image is supplied.
clients.mustAvoid: No personalised legal advice, deadlines, guaranteed outcomes, fees, success rates, jurisdiction or practitioner qualifications inferred from old material. Do not borrow the separate Lydenburg practice's facts, use HMHI as the public brand, invent staff roles or confidential case stories, or create court imagery that appears documentary.
clients.channelIntegration: Keep the Hill, McHardy & Herbst public identity consistent on channels already managed for this exact firm. General education uses the confirmed website or no footer; a consultation contact block needs a current brief and fresh verification. No new platform entitlement is implied.

guide_quotes: A long-established Bloemfontein neighbourhood butchery that should market real meat, real counter craft, practical buying help and local braai/family occasions without generic supermarket or luxury-meat filler.
Never assume a historical product, cut, pack or price is available today.
These are idea systems, not fixed weekly obligations.
clients.audienceAndIntent: Help someone choosing meat for a real meal or braai understand the product actually pictured and the counter service actually shown. Use the neighbourhood butchery voice rather than inventing customer segments, favourite-product rankings or today's catalogue.
clients.formatsAndRationale: One professional video can show real counter preparation. Three photo posts can pair an actual product with its preparation and useful meal context; four design posters clarify those ideas with title and subtitle. Reels and animation remain unknown, and these angles do not create weekly obligations.
clients.mustAvoid: No assumed current stock, pack weights, prices, meat grade, origin, supplier, certifications, health benefits, guaranteed tenderness or delivery terms. Keep the 5-versus-55 address and footer/WhatsApp conflicts unresolved until confirmed. No invented customer testimony, best-seller claim or standing special; preserve real products, labels and people.
clients.channelIntegration: Let the video, photographs and posters tell complementary parts of the same real product/counter story on the channels already managed. Captions add a practical second layer instead of copying the artwork. Confirm the footer choice rather than spreading conflicting address or contact details.
